{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
data['revenue_clean'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
data_clean = data[data['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99].copy()

# Filter out refunded orders (they are not completed revenue)
data_completed = data_clean[data_clean['status'] == 'completed'].copy()

# Check the final dataset
final_rows = len(data_completed)
print(f'Final dataset (completed orders only, no QA): {final_rows}')

# Compute conversion rate by channel
table = data_completed.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean().round(4)
print(f'Conversion rate by channel:\n{table}')

# Compute average revenue by channel
avg_revenue_by_channel = data_completed.groupby('channel')['revenue_clean'].mean().round(2)
print(f'Average revenue by channel:\n{avg_revenue_by_channel}')

# Compute total revenue by channel
total_revenue_by_channel = data_completed.groupby('channel')['revenue_clean'].sum().round(2)
print(f'Total revenue by channel:\n{total_revenue_by_channel}')

# Group by customer segment to check for imbalance
segment_counts = data_completed.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
print(f'Customer segment distribution by channel:\n{segment_counts}')

# Final summary
conversion_rate_email = table['email']
conversion_rate_paid_search = table['paid_search']

# Compute the difference in conversion rates
conversion_diff = conversion_rate_email - conversion_rate_paid_search

# Compute the average revenue difference
revenue_diff = avg_revenue_by_channel['email'] - avg_revenue_by_channel['paid_search']

print(f'Conversion rate difference (email - paid_search): {conversion_diff:.4f}')
print(f'Average revenue difference (email - paid_search): {revenue_diff:.2f}')"}
